wholePhysicalScope: The named current OSM building relation supplies the three radial buttress outlines, hexagonal central shaft, entry envelope, and the distinct radial profiles of both pods and mast.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the tower buttresses, radome, stacked observation decks, SkyPod and broadcast mast. Nearer levels resolve elevator glazing, window mullions and mast details.
limitations: This replaces the provisional tower asset in its existing catalog location and covers the tower itself; the aquarium, adjacent SkyWalk, stadia, and interiors are outside scope.
Current plan geometry and the tower operator’s elevations govern the major forms. The exact shape of the transitions, glazing subdivision, plinth details and communications equipment are estimated.
Ground elevation is an unmodified Terrarium sample; individual thresholds and the elevation of the surrounding paved plaza are approximate.
